translationRepairs: Yonghe 3, ninth month: the earth shook on jimao and again on gengyin.
Jianhe 3, ninth month: the earth shook on jimao and again on gengyin.
Bare 三年 follows 桓帝建和元年 (s0075) and precedes 元嘉元年 (s0080); the digression in s0078 does not change the era, so Yonghe 3 is wrong and Jianhe 3 is correct.
On the day yihai in the third month of the third year the capital, Jincheng, and Longxi suffered earthquakes and splitting; many city walls and houses were ruined, and people were crushed to death.
On the day yihai in the second month of the third year the capital, Jincheng, and Longxi suffered earthquakes and splitting; many city walls and houses were ruined, and people were crushed to death.
Chinese 三年二月乙亥 has 二月; the literal English wrongly says the third month, and the proposed second month matches the source.
Yuanchu 4, summer: Pei and Bohai counted thirty thousand trees down.
Yuanchu 6, fourth month of summer: Pei and Bohai counted thirty thousand trees down.
Chinese 六年夏四月 under the Yuanchu sequence begun at s0163 is year 6, summer fourth month; the idiomatic Yuanchu 4 and omitted month are errors, and the proposed wording restores both.
In the sixth month of summer of the fourth year Pei and Bohai had a great wind that uprooted more than thirty thousand trees.
In the fourth month of summer of the sixth year Pei and Bohai had a great wind that uprooted more than thirty thousand trees.
Chinese 六年夏四月 is the sixth year and the fourth month of summer; the literal English swaps them into fourth year and sixth month, and the proposal corrects both.
